sentences.text: Shri Manoj Kumar Singh - Panel Lawyer for the State.
Heard on I.A. No.8230/2022, which is second application under Section 389 (1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of custodial sentence on behalf of the appellant No.1 - Pawan Kumar Verma.

First application has been dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 14.02.2022.
2.

The appellant has been convicted under Section 120-B and 420/120B of IPC and sentenced to undergo RI for 2 years with fine Rs.1,000/- and RI for 5 years with fine Rs.5,000/- respectively;
with default stipulation.

3. It is alleged that appellant No.2 Pradeep Kumar Verma and appellant No. 3 Sandeep Kumar Verma issued no objection certificate in the form of affidavit in favour of their brother Pawan Kumar Verma to the society to transfer the plot said to be allotted in the name of their mother Anjana Verma, wife of Suresh Chandra Verma.

The allegation in this case is that appellant/applicant Pawan Kumar Verma, taking advantage of similarity in the parents name approached the society to transfer a plot allotted to a person who was having the similar name and co-incidentally the husband name as Pawan Kumar Verma claimed the name of his parents, i.e., Anjana Verma W/o Suresh Chandra Verma got the plot transferred in his name and surrendered/sold it to third person and thus obtained undue monetary benefit by cheating.
4. It is submitted by the counsel for the appellant that the appellant is in jail since 27.11.2021 and has completed more than one year in custody.
It is further submitted that appeal would take time to be heard finally, therefore, his sentence may be suspended.
5. Learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the prayer.

6. Having regard to the nature and gravity of allegation made against the appellant; period of custody as also the fact that the appeal would take time to be heard finally, I.A. No. 8230/2022 is allowed.

7. It is directed that on deposition of entire fine amount, if not already deposited and also on furnishing personal bond of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in Pawan Kumar Verma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88317808/

8. List the matter for final hearing in due course.
